services.title: Emergency Burst Pipes
services.desc: Pipe burst at 2am? We're on call 24/7. Our engineers locate the leak, stop the damage, and repair it — usually the same day.

services.desc: Annual boiler services keep your heating running safely and efficiently. Repairs diagnosed on the van mean fewer trips and lower costs.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Installations
services.desc: New suite or upgrade? We handle pipework, fitting, and testing. Your bathroom or kitchen is finished to standard and on budget.

services.title: Blocked Drains & Unblocking
services.desc: Slow drain or backed-up system? We use CCTV to pinpoint the blockage and clear it with minimal mess or disruption.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: New system or full replacement. We design layouts, install to Building Regulations, and test everything before we leave.

services.title: Radiator Repairs & Replacements

about_pullquote: I started this business because I hate cowboys overcharging people.
about_para_1: First Choice Plumbing was founded 15 years ago on a simple promise: arrive fast, work cleanly, and charge fair prices. We've grown from a one-man operation to a trusted team that handles everything from burst pipes to full central heating installations across Sunderland and the North East. Every engineer carries parts on the van and the experience to solve most problems before they leave your home.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on turning up on time, finishing the job properly, and treating your home with respect. We're not the cheapest, but we're the fastest and most reliable — which is why 70% of our work comes from repeat customers and word-of-mouth referrals. When you call First Choice, you get a local engineer who knows Sunderland's properties and won't oversell you work you don't need.
reviews_heading: What Sunderland Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe on a Sunday morning — absolute nightmare. Called First Choice at 8am and Mark was here by 9.15. Had the leak found and fixed by 10.30. Brilliant service, fair price, and he even cleaned up the mess. Can't ask for more than that.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: New boiler installation. The engineer turned up on time, explained everything clearly, and got it fitted and tested same day. Came in on budget. Why are other plumbers so hard to deal with? Cheers lads.
reviews.author: Lisa T.

reviews.text: Blocked drain was driving me mad. They sent someone out within the hour, used a camera to see exactly where the problem was, cleared it without digging up the garden. Honest lot. Will use them again.
reviews.author: Chris H.
